description: This file contains functions related to upgrading an SD card's image and partition layout, including image extraction, partition comparison, device writing, and configuration copying. It appears to be part of a larger upgrade mechanism for embedded devices or similar hardware.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the partition layout of the provided image matches the existing device, and prompts for confirmation if it differs.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process by writing the image to the device, handling partition changes and bootloader updates.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Backs up configuration files from the device partition to the host.
